translations.web: the field is the world; and the good seed, these are the children of the Kingdom; and the darnel weeds are the children of the evil one.
translations.bsb: The field is the world, and the good seed represents the sons of the kingdom. The weeds are the sons of the evil one,
translations.kjv: The field is the world; the good seed are the children of the kingdom; but the tares are the children of the wicked
